entries.b58aa848f2f4e60c: The company's basic management policy is to establish its position as a 'distribution platformer in the magazine publishing industry' that connects subscribers and publishers through 'Fujisan.co.jp'. In its medium- to long-term strategy, the company states that it will promote the spread of subscription as a form of reading through subscriber-only benefits and bundled offers of digital magazines, and will advance a Special Partner Strategy under which it undertakes the reception, payment and delivery operations related to subscriptions. It also states that it will provide new revenue sources for publishers, such as an EC platform based on subscription information and sales support on a per-article basis, and will develop new markets not dependent on the magazine publishing market through the EdTech Business, which began in July 2024.
